summary: End-to-end tested Studio Settings panel + Inquiry Inbox Mark-as-Replied / filters. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases passed (GET/PUT /api/settings auth + https prepend + empty link, inquiry create defaults to 'new', PATCH status replied/new/invalid/bad id/unknown/missing-auth, regression on media/reviews/root). Frontend: admin login works, Studio Settings panel loads values and saves successfully with success toast ('Moved back to New.' / save works), map preview iframe renders; inquiry inbox shows status badges + toggle (data-status flips new<->replied, button text toggles 'Mark as Replied' <-> 'Mark as New'); filter All/New/Replied counts correct (4/3/1); new-count badge shows '3 new'. Public home page: #contact Booking section shows studio_address, booking-address-link opens Google Maps with encoded query, map iframe src contains encoded 'Narra%20St.' address. Footer shows studio address and all 3 social links with hrefs from settings. Settings restored to defaults at end.

ui_bugs.issue: Social icons render even when the link in settings is empty string. Spec requires: if a social link is empty, that icon should disappear from footer. Current code maps SOCIALS unconditionally -> renders <a href="">. Fix: wrap with .filter(({key}) => settings[key]) before .map.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> inside <option> (rating select in Admin.jsx line ~375). Caused by preview tooling injecting x-* wrapper spans into <option> children. Low priority visual-editor artifact; does not break UX but logs console error on every admin visit.

action_items: Footer.jsx: filter out empty social links before mapping (so empty settings hide the icon per spec).
Optional: avoid rendering span wrappers inside <option> tags in Admin.jsx rating select to silence React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_settings strips whitespace globally — fine, but SettingsInput has defaults for all fields; if a client PUTs partial payload omitting a field, Pydantic fills with default (potentially overwriting a stored custom value). Consider making fields Optional[str] = None and only $set provided keys.
Footer.jsx missing conditional for empty social links (noted above).
Admin.jsx uses data-testid='admin-inquiry-item-{id}' while the review request wording called it 'card'. Both parties should align the convention; current implementation is fine functionally.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test inquiry (name='TEST_Playwright') via POST /api/inquiries; left in DB with status reverted to 'new'. Admin inbox currently shows 4 inquiries (3 new, 1 replied). Settings restored to documented defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (pytest). All green. Only outstanding issue is Footer not hiding empty-string social icons per spec. Admin uses data-testid=admin-inquiry-item-{id} (not -card-). mapEmbedUrl properly URI-encodes the address.
